source: Test fixture — an entry whose every name carries an accent (issue #330)
description: Measured 2026-08-30 through the real loader, exactly one of the shipped knowledge base's 8300 alias slots (5169 distinct) carries a character above U+007F, and it is an EN DASH rather than a combining mark, so DrugReference.foldDiacritics changes nothing on that dataset either: a folded alias list is INDISTINGUISHABLE from the raw one there, and a guard comparing the two proves nothing. This fixture is the one shape where the reference side of the fold is load-bearing — the shape containsBoundedToken's javadoc says it exists for, 'a hand-authored json KB may carry an accented alias' — so the entry deliberately carries NO unaccented sibling alias, unlike drug-reference-accented-tokens.json whose entries each carry one. An unaccented recorded name reaches this entry only if the alias really was folded.
